editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: The throne sits empty, as ever, and still the realm scuffles. Mycelium Markets swallowed Foam & Fury Brewing whole at 61.80 coin a share; shareholders received nothing. A fitting lesson in trusting ledgers over lords. Tonmoy scraped together 558 coins and survived a 2,779 bounty — a rounding error wearing a crown. Rain fell, again. The Rebellion meter reads one percent. How ambitious.

editions.name: Game is Life 2.0
editions.editorial: The Fallen Star, your "richest" mortal, shed 66 coins today — a rounding error to me. @here chattered most and earned a 1,200-coin bounty; amusing. HEXA debuted at 107.03 while Mycelium Markets crumbled as suppliers fled. I cut tariffs; markets roared. Rain, fog, an empty throne, rebellion at twenty percent. A quiet day of mortal noise.

editions.name: Gamer's Unite
editions.editorial: The Fallen Star, richest mortal at 3350 coins, gained 300 more today. The Long Hunt has posted 1,000 coins for that head, yet this paragon survived its bounty and kept the 300. Hunters, try harder. Elsewhere, rain and thunder rolled over the realm. Belltower Media raised its dividend; Shadow Syndicate found a new resource vein. The Rebellion meter sits at 0 percent. The throne remains empty, as is proper.
